source_tree.definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

bounded_seams: The audit accepts a primary and additional required-combination definition, merges only declared fixture files and loads unchanged pinned main.js bytes through the same context-isolated renderer wrapper.
Minimal + Minimal Theme Settings + Style Settings verifies the pinned Minimal 9.1.0 manifest/theme.css assets before running the PC08/PC17 wrapper.
TaskNotes + Bases verifies the declared file-based Bases fixture paths before exercising the PC19 task projection and all lifecycle phases.
Combination traces record target IDs in the worker, per-plugin mediated persistence, cleanup, return-to-Obsidian state and zero direct vault writes.

Required combinations disable competing automatic writers by default and run a separate process.spawn denial probe that records each member's persisted marker, registration cleanup and deterministic deny-clear-return recovery.
implementation.security_disposition: Unchanged pinned artifacts remain inside the context-isolated synthetic renderer. Dependency assets and Bases fixture bytes are integrity-checked or mediated in memory; no host vault, OS clipboard or direct vault writer is accessed.

limitation: This evidence exercises unchanged pinned artifacts only inside the hidden Electron context-isolated sandbox. Required-combination recovery probes disable automatic writers and preserve deterministic per-member persisted markers through a synthetic process denial, but they remain bounded implementation evidence and do not certify stock Obsidian, reference behavior, hostile same-user OS isolation, human behavior or compatibility promotion.
